description: FREE for the delayed sample; the endpoint's x402 price applies for live data (from $0.001/call). Fetch data from an endpoint returned by search_market_data. Without a subscription this returns a REAL but delayed sample at no cost — enough to see the exact response shape and judge the data. With an active subscription key it returns live data. Live data is also purchasable per call in USDC over x402 at https://api.losbeto.xyz.
name: get_market_data
